Subject: SEEKING PRODUCER FOR "THE LION" SHORT FILM
 

The Lion

A Senior Thesis Project



Written and Directed by Jack Preston

Produced by … you?



One of our actors ^




Logline: In late Medieval France two knights arrange a private duel to settle a feud, but when one knight lies dead at the end, his noble house pushes his squire to settle the score. 




Shooting tentatively early April



This film features real people in real armor using real medieval sword fighting techniques, adhering to the researched cultures of the time period.




Seeking:

Producer




Sign up for an online meeting here. Or email me directly at Jsnell1@saic.edu!




Script can be read here

Note: this is a project involving heavy (and continuing) research and the script is subject to further change

Hi, I’m Jack! I am a film student at the School of the Art Institute of Chicago. That's a bit south of Northwestern, but it certainly won't be the first time I work cross-school. I am a senior and will be graduating this spring. This is my capstone/thesis, and I have been researching it for a while now. It's worth noting that this project might be a bit of a sprint, but I’m excited to get it into production!

subject: Come see a new staged reading about screenwriters and Asian representation!
body_text:
Hey, RTVF!

Hope you're all enjoying the warmer weather as of this week! I'm reaching out to let people know that I've written a full-length play going up as a staged reading tomorrow and Friday called...

The Spirit of Renewal

The Wirtz Center Presents

A Week 7 SPP Staged Reading

Written by James Y. Lee

Directed by Emerson Steady

Produced by Wylde Laden

Wirtz 201

Thursday, February 19 — 8:30PM

Friday, February 20 — 7:00PM

Free admission!

If you're interested in seeing a feature-length story about Hollywood in 2021, screenwriting, fantasy media franchises, and Asian representation in the industry, come on down to the Wirtz Center at the times listed above to see our show! We've worked for quite a bit on this process, and we hope to tell a story that resonates with anyone wondering what it means to be an artist — of all demographics, career levels, stages of life, etc. — in an ever-changing, constantly shifting media landscape.

Hope to see you there!

Best,
-- 
James Y. Lee
Northwestern University '26 | RTVF | School of Communication
Chicago Indie Critics and GALECA Member
Website: https://jamesylee.com/

subject: Re: Join Us Feb. 18 – Q&A with Actor Anna Baryshnikov & Director Nastasya Popov (Harris 107, 7:30 PM)
body_text: Q&A with Anna Baryshnikov and Nastasya Popov happening tonight! Join us in Harris 107 at 7:30pm :)
body_html:
Q&A with Anna Baryshnikov and Nastasya Popov happening tonight! Join us in Harris 107 at 7:30pm :)

On Sun, Feb 15, 2026 at 7:33 PM NUWFA Exec <nuwfaexec@gmail.com> wrote:
Hello aspiring storytellers,

We are excited to invite you to a special event on Wednesday, February 18 at 7:30 PM in Harris 107, featuring a conversation with actor Anna Baryshnikov and director Nastasya Popov.

 

This is a unique opportunity to meet the two creative forces behind the critically anticipated feature film Idiotka — a 2025 American comedy that premiered at the South by Southwest (SXSW) Film Festival and was subsequently picked up for distribution by Utopia, a company known for supporting distinctive independent voices in cinema. Idiotka follows an aspiring fashion designer navigating a reality TV competition to help her family and blends satire with heartfelt storytelling.

About Our Guests:
    •    Anna Baryshnikov is an American actress best known for her roles in Manchester by the Sea, the CBS sitcom Superior Donuts, and Apple TV+’s Dickinson. In Idiotka, she leads the film as Margarita, an ambitious designer trying to save her family’s apartment through a high-stakes reality show. She trained at Northwestern University and has earned recognition for her versatility across comedy and drama.
    •    Nastasya Popov is a Los Angeles–based writer, director, and producer. Idiotka is her feature-length directorial debut, which premiered at SXSW 2025 and has been praised for its fresh voice and comedic insight. Popov holds a BA in Creative Nonfiction and Slavic Literature from Northwestern University and has an impressive background in both documentary and narrative filmmaking.
 
Whether you’re interested in acting, directing, writing, editing, or independent film distribution, this event offers a behind-the-scenes look at the creative process and an opportunity to ask questions about the journey from script to festival to distribution. We hope you’ll join us!

<3 NUWFA Exec
